tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Search WoW lore and Forever reference data. Exact-name matches rank first. Every hit carries its source and licence.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Fetch the full record behind a search hit id, for page rendering.

tools.name: get_by_name
tools.description: Exact full-name match (case-insensitive) for disambiguation.

tools.name: search
tools.description: The same search as search_knowledge, in the shape ChatGPT connectors and deep research call by name: up to 10 results, each with an id for fetch, a title and a URL to cite. The text block is the same JSON as a string.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: One knowledge record by the id a search result gave, whole: title, the full text in the source's words, the URL to cite, and metadata with the source, licence and date. The text block is the same JSON as a string.

tools.name: answer_sources
tools.description: The evidence behind a question about WoW: Forever, for an answer that cites its sources: facts players observed (public after three installs agree, with the install count), curated facts, and the 2023 Warcraft Wiki (marked: may differ in Forever). Every piece carries a claim, its source URL, licence

tools.name: profession_path
tools.description: Leveling path for one Forever profession from Everloot uploads. A step exists only after 3 installs agree: on a reported recipe, or on the recipe colours that make it orange (a guaranteed skill-up), starting at the trainer's required rank. Gold exists only after 3 price uploads agree. No copied guid

tools.name: recipe_thresholds
tools.description: Where a Forever profession's recipes turn yellow, green and grey, inferred from the colours players' trade-skill windows showed. A recipe appears only after 3 installs agree, as ranges, never guessed exact numbers. Agreed reagents come with an estimated cost per craft when every reagent has an agree

tools.name: item_page
tools.description: One Forever item: agreed name, observed loot-window drop frequency, agreed map pins, and player-reported armor, block, damage per second, stats and resistances. Each item number needs one value with 3 agreeing installs in the newest build with 3 reporting installs, and no competing value with 3; con

tools.name: npc_page
tools.description: One Forever NPC: agreed name and map pins, and loot windows reported but not yet in the rates. A name or pin needs 3 installs agreeing. The pin does not require a drop. No copied spawn list. Reads Everloot's current authorized public corpus when connected. Missing or unavailable data is reported exp

tools.name: object_page
tools.description: One game object (a chest, herb, ore vein or fishing pool) by the id in its GUID: the items players looted from it, each with observed loot windows, windows with the item and distinct install reports. tools.name: quest_page
tools.description: One Forever quest: agreed title, level, giver, turn-in, and rewards. Each fact needs 3 installs agreeing. No copied quest text. Reads Everloot's current authorized public corpus when connected. Missing or unavailable data is reported explicitly.

tools.name: vendor_page
tools.description: Goods one Forever vendor sells. An item is listed when 3 installs agree on that item and its copper price. Two agreed prices both stay listed. No copied catalog. Reads Everloot's current authorized public corpus when connected. Missing or unavailable data is reported explicitly.

tools.name: world_map_near

tools.description: Guilds whose name starts with what you typed, each with its realm, faction, how many characters the addon saw in it, and the count and date of its agreed boss kills. A guild is listed once its members' uploads agree on a kill (2 installs reporting the same guild and boss), once its officers publishe

tools.name: guild_rankings
tools.description: Every guild with an agreed kill in one instance, ordered by bosses killed, then by who reached its latest kill first, then by name; equal rows share a rank. A kill is a guild's once 2 of its members' installs report the same boss there, timed at the earliest report, or once its officers published it

tools.name: auction_history
tools.description: Price history from auction scans players uploaded on purpose. A day is public after 3 installs scanned that item on that realm. Copper is the median. Reads Everloot's current authorized public corpus when connected. Missing or unavailable data is reported explicitly.

tools.name: market_value
tools.description: Market value, minimum buyout, historical value and units listed for one item on one WoW: Forever realm, from full auction scans players started and uploaded. tools.name: coverage
tools.description: How much of WoW: Forever's database is settled or confirmed, and which reported fields need more agreeing installs. tools.name: population
tools.description: How many characters play each race, class, race and class, faction and level band on WoW: Forever, from the census of players who turned it on in the Everloot addon. Each character counts once. A count shows only when it covers at least 10 characters reported by at least 3 installs from at least 3 a

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Newest first: Blizzard blue posts (title, author, time, a short excerpt and the link to the original), hotfix posts, and new game builds. Excerpts only: Blizzard's post text is Blizzard's; full posts are available at their source URLs. A build's time is when Everloot first saw it, not Blizzard's rel

tools.name: ecosystem_projects
tools.description: Forever addons and tools from the community registry, with a board ranking: most installed, rising, most active, freshest release or best maintained. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, answer_sources · Private data: get_entity, fetch, world_map_near, entity_relations, item_categories, talent_tree, talent_plan, class_races, coverage · Public sink: talent_tree, talent_plan, completion_progress, guild_board, guild_rankings, market_value, gold_ledger, recent_changes · Destructive: item_page, npc_page, guild_search, guild_rankings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, answer_sources · Private data: get_entity, fetch, world_map_near, entity_relations, item_categories, talent_tree, talent_plan, class_races, coverage · Public sink: talent_tree, talent_plan, completion_progress, guild_board, guild_rankings, market_value, gold_ledger, recent_changes · Destructive: item_page, npc_page, guild_search, guild_rankings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "talent_plan" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: code
